context: You will hear a woman phoning an adult learning centre to enrol on a language course.

script.t: Good morning, City Adult Learning Centre. How can I help?
Hello. I'm calling about your evening courses. I'd like to learn Spanish.
Lovely. We've got two levels starting next month: beginners and intermediate. Have you studied Spanish before?
Only a little at school, years ago. I think beginners would be best.
OK. The beginners' class is on Tuesday evenings. Oh, wait, sorry, that's changed this term. It's on Thursday evenings now, from seven till nine.
Thursday's fine. Where is it held?
In the Mitchell Building, room 12. That's on Park Road, opposite the hospital.
And how long does the course last?
It's ten weeks, starting on the 6th of October.
How much does it cost?
The full fee is 180 pounds, but if you're over sixty or unemployed, it's reduced to 95.
I'm afraid I'm not either of those. Does the price include books?
No, you'll need to buy the course book, which is about 20 pounds. Everything else is provided.
OK. Can I enrol over the phone?
Yes. Can I have your full name, please?
It's Anna Kowalski. K-O-W-A-L-S-K-I.
Thank you. How did you hear about the course, by the way?
A friend told me about it. Actually, I first saw a poster in the library, but my friend recommended it too.
We'll put 'poster' then. Is there anything we should know, any special requirements?
Well, I use a wheelchair, so I'd need step-free access.
That's no problem. The Mitchell Building has a lift at the side entrance.
